pack.topic: Basement Parking Overhead Drainage Pipeline Leakage Inspection
pack.source_script_insight: Overhead drainage pipe joint leakage in basement parking causes water pooling and vehicle damage, highlighting poor MEP workmanship during handover.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Apartment buyers in RS Puram or Peelamedu must inspect basement parking ceilings during handing over to prevent long-term seepage onto cars.
pack.core_takeaway: Check overhead PVC drainage joints in apartment basements before handover.

pack.title_english: Basement Pipe Leak Check Before Apartment Handover in Coimbatore
pack.caption_english: Spotting overhead water leaks in apartment basement parking is crucial before taking handover in Coimbatore. Poor PVC drainage pipe joint sealing can damage parked vehicles and weaken overhead concrete slabs over time. Always inspect MEP systems thoroughly. Build smart with OliveTree Builders.
